title: Crash when Script extends via UID
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.6.stable.arch_linux

### System information

Operating System: Manjaro Linux  KDE Plasma Version: 6.5.5 KDE Frameworks Version: 6.23.0 Qt Version: 6.10.2 Kernel Version: 6.18.12-1-MANJARO (64-bit) Graphics Platform: Wayland Processors: 24 × AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor Memory: 128 GiB of RAM (125,7 GiB usable) Graphics Processor: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT Manufacturer: Gigabyte Technology Co., Ltd. Product Name: B550 AORUS ELITE AX V2

### Issue description

When a script extends another script by using `uid://`, saving the script results in a crash.
Using `res://` does not result in a crash.

### Steps to reproduce

In the MRP are three script files.
* Open `ChildUID.gd`
* Press CTRL+S to save it
* Wait for it to crash
